notice: External documents below are publicly verifiable safety references, NOT the approved plant SOPs and NOT proof of each instruction in these illustrative examples. OSHA references are US regulations; applicability in India varies. OISD standard-catalogue links verify a standard exists but do not supply its full text. Site approval and equipment-specific procedures are still necessary.

SOP-GC-004.title: 29 CFR 1910.38(c) — emergency reporting, evacuation, accountability
SOP-GC-004.relevance: General emergency-plan framework, not an approved compressor-skid leak procedure.

SOP-GC-004.title: OISD-STD-116 — fire protection for oil/gas processing plants
SOP-GC-004.type: Official catalogue listing; full standard not supplied
SOP-GC-004.relevance: Relevant standard to consult; no specific steps copied or asserted from an unavailable text.

SOP-GC-004.title: Oil & gas incident case studies, including compressor-house incidents
SOP-GC-004.relevance: Context for training scenarios, not an operating SOP.

SOP-CP-002.title: 29 CFR 1910.119(f) — written operating procedures and emergency shutdown/startup phases
SOP-CP-002.relevance: Sets general principles; does not specify compressor first-out troubleshooting, lube-oil checks or restart clearance for a particular plant.

SOP-CP-002.title: Compressor-house fire and other OISD incident case studies
SOP-CP-002.relevance: Incident-learning context, not a replacement for an equipment manufacturer's manual.

SOP-PTW-001.title: OISD-STD-105 — Work Permit System (August 2023 edition in catalogue)
SOP-PTW-001.type: Official catalogue listing; full standard not supplied
SOP-PTW-001.relevance: India-specific reference to procure and review; these demo sections are not claimed to reproduce OISD's text.

SOP-PTW-001.title: 29 CFR 1910.119(f)(4) — safe work practices
SOP-PTW-001.relevance: General work-control principles, not a site's issued permit.

SOP-GT-003.title: 29 CFR 1910.146(d)(5) — atmospheric testing for permit-required confined spaces
SOP-GT-003.relevance: Confined-space context only. OSHA's confined-space hazard thresholds are NOT necessarily plant gas-detector alarm setpoints.

SOP-GT-003.title: 29 CFR 1910.146 Appendix B — procedures for atmospheric testing
SOP-GT-003.relevance: Test-equipment and testing-practice background, not the facility's alarm matrix.

SOP-PPE-005.title: 29 CFR 1910 Subpart I Appendix B — PPE hazard assessment and selection
SOP-PPE-005.relevance: Supports selection principles; actual PPE must follow plant-specific risk assessment.

SOP-EC-006.title: 29 CFR 1910.38(c) — emergency reporting, evacuation and accounting for personnel
SOP-EC-006.relevance: General planning requirements; site alarm channels and muster procedures remain site-specific.

SOP-EC-006.title: OISD-STD-116 — fire protection for processing plants
SOP-EC-006.type: Official catalogue listing; full standard not supplied
SOP-EC-006.relevance: Relevant Indian standards catalogue, not a reproduced approved communication plan.
